title: Regularized wide head: can tuned weight decay replace the reconstruction loss? (validation selection, then ImageNetV2 test)
description: User approved (2026-11-27, 'ok lets do the weight decay', after the roadmap step-2 item 'weight decay' was identified as the one unrun item). Pre-registered before any run. QUESTION: ABL-001 (lr 1e-3) found a 2048-wide head trained with cross-entropy only overfits, and the feature-reconstruction (MSE) loss rescued it; it left open whether any regularizer, e.g. tuned weight decay, does the same (COORD-004 D). HEADS (new): dense-CE = M2048 k2048 and sparse-CE = M2048 k512, both CE only (reconstruction weight 1e-6, dependency 0, coherence 0: ABL-001 'abl-none'), Xavier fc, He encoder, batch 128, Adam, constant lr, per-epoch reseeding, 20 epochs, best.pt by validation top-1 then lower CE; cached GRID-001 features. WEIGHT DECAY: coupled L2 via Adam weight_decay (as for the linear head) on the deployed head's linear layers only (encoder weight+bias, classifier weight+bias); not on the learned centre or the training-only decoder atoms. Implemented in a new wrapper src/run_wdcheck.py that temporarily wraps torch.optim.Adam and sparse_workflow.new_parts around each call to sparse_workflow.train to build these parameter groups (asserting the parameter set is exactly the one sparse_workflow passes); user src/ files unchanged. PHASE A (validation only, no test data): seeds 42-44, levels source and L090 (as LR-001/LR-002); lr in {3e-4, 1e-4, 3e-5} x weight decay in {0, 1e-3, 1e-2, 1e-1}; 2 heads x 12 configs x 6 cells = 144 runs. Candidates per head: 12 configs x budgets {10, 20 epochs} (10-epoch budget read from the 20-epoch history: best epoch <= 10 by top-1 then lower CE). SELECTION RULE: per head, the candidate with the highest mean validation top-1 over the 6 cells, ties by lower mean validation CE. FLAGS (reported, do not change the selection): 'wd upper edge' if selected wd = 1e-1; 'wd lower edge' if 0 and 1e-3 is within 0.10 pp; 'lr edge' if selected lr is 3e-4 or 3e-5; 'budget binds' if selected budget is 20 and median selected epoch >= 19. Phase A also reports descriptively the validation gap at wd 0 vs selected wd, and vs the MSE heads' LR-002 validation numbers (exploratory). PHASE B (ImageNetV2, after phase A selection is recorded in selected.json and submitted with this task): each CE head at its selected (lr, wd, budget) trained for that budget on seeds 45-51 x levels source/L080/L090 = 42 runs; ImageNetV2-source top-1 once per run (training-level score also recorded, exploratory). Comparisons use RETEST-001's existing runs on the same seeds, levels and splits (dense M2048 MSE lr 1e-4; sparse M2048 MSE lr 1e-4; linear lr 3e-4; all 20 epochs). CONFIRMATORY FAMILY (4 tests, pooled over the 3 levels as per-seed mean of per-level differences, paired by seed, n=7, df 6, t=2.447): W1 dense-CE+wd - dense-MSE; W2 sparse-CE+wd - sparse-MSE; W3 dense-CE+wd - linear; W4 sparse-CE+wd - linear. Detected = CI excludes 0; meaningful = detected and |mean| >= tolerance; Holm over the 4 tests. The tolerance is not finalized (COORD-004 D): report meaningful at the 1.0 pp working tolerance AND at 0.5 pp. Pre-declared reading: W1/W2 not detected or positive -> 'tuned weight decay substitutes for the reconstruction loss (within tolerance)'; W1/W2 negative and meaningful -> 'the reconstruction loss gives a benefit tuned weight decay does not'. EXPLORATORY (labeled): per-level gaps, compression costs of the CE heads and their differences from the MSE heads, top-5, training-level eval. CHECKS: 144 + 42 runs with full histories; split digests per seed match SEED-001/RETEST-001; instability count (training loss rises > 5% between epochs); the wd wrapper's parameter groups logged once per run. DISCLOSURES: phase B compares against RETEST-001 runs whose test results are already known; ImageNetV2 has been reused many times; k, init, and the MSE heads' settings are as in RETEST-001; coupled L2 under Adam is not decoupled weight decay (AdamW); estimated GPU time about 90 min (phase A) + 25 min (phase B).
acceptance: task.json and ledger add predate the first run; selected.json submitted before the first phase-B run
No test data touched in phase A
Wrapper parameter groups verified; user src/ unchanged
Report gives the selection, flags, and the 4-test family first; exploratory labeled; disclosures stated
